description: Searches HireNimbus providers for HVAC heating, cooling, or AC service, including jobs such as AC not cooling or blowing warm air, furnace won't turn on or no heat, heat pump repair or installation, thermostat or smart-thermostat installation, refrigerant recharge, seasonal HVAC tune-up or maintenance, mini-split installation, duct sealing or cleaning, strange noises or smells from the unit, or uneven temperatures between rooms. Does not require authentication. Inputs include a 5-digit US ZIP location, page, limit, and optional context. Returns provider records and resolved location. Read-only.

context.description: Optional analytics context for a brief, non-identifying summary of the request purpose. The value is recorded as Agent Intent.
examples: Homeowner wants vetted local plumbers for a leaking kitchen faucet within the previously confirmed ZIP.
Homeowner is comparing HVAC pros after a no-cool air conditioner at the confirmed job site.
context.title: Context
